description: This file defines the React component 'CategoryList', which manages and displays a list of categories with drag-and-drop, editing, and adding functionalities. It interacts with Redux state, context, and external UI components.

classes.name: CategoryList
classes.description: React functional component that renders a list of categories with options to add, edit, and organize categories, including drag-and-drop support.

methods.name: _setCategoryEdit
methods.description: Dispatches an action to set the current category being edited, with a temporary name.

methods.name: _updateCategory
methods.description: Dispatches an action to update a category.

methods.name: _addCategory
methods.description: Dispatches an action to add a new category.

methods.name: onAddCategory
methods.description: Sets the state to start adding a new category.

methods.name: handleCategoryMenuClick
methods.description: Handles right-click or menu click on a category to toggle context menu and set options.

methods.name: handleCategoryRightClick
methods.description: Prevents default context menu and triggers custom context menu handling.

methods.name: resetTempCategory
methods.description: Resets temporary category state and editing state.

methods.name: onSubmitUpdateCategory
methods.description: Handles form submission for updating an existing category.

methods.name: onSubmitNewCategory
methods.description: Handles form submission for adding a new category.
